# Claiming Social Security early and still working: how much is withheld, and does it come back?

> Free Social Security earnings test calculator: if you claim before full retirement age and keep working, see how many months of benefits are withheld each year, the net dollars held back, the higher benefit you get at full retirement age and when it pays back. Private, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
